disclosures.title_en:
Management of material topics

Additional sector recommendations

  • Describe the means for identifying stakeholders and engaging with local communities.
  • List the vulnerable groups that the organization has identified.
  • List any objective or individual rights that the organization has determined to be of particular concern to the local communities.1
  • Describe the approach of the organization to engaging with vulnerable groups, including:
    • How it seeks to ensure engagement is meaningful, and
    • How it seeks to ensure safe and equitable gender participation.
| 11, 15, 1 |
